_comment: JARVIS OS - Extended Job Application Profile
_guide: Fill ALL fields. This covers every question asked by Workday, Lever, Greenhouse, iCIMS, Naukri, LinkedIn Easy Apply.
summary: Backend Engineer with 2+ years of experience building scalable APIs and distributed systems using Python, FastAPI, Node.js, and PostgreSQL. Passionate about developer tooling, AI automation, and building products that improve human productivity.
cover_letter_template:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the {role} position at {company}. With my background in backend engineering and AI systems, I believe I can make a strong contribution to your team.

I have built scalable APIs, worked with PostgreSQL and vector databases, and have a passion for automation and AI-driven workflows. I am particularly drawn to {company} because of {company_reason}.

I look forward to discussing how my skills align with your needs.

Best regards,
Rahul Patil
why_this_company: I admire the mission and engineering culture at {company}. The work aligns perfectly with my expertise in backend systems and AI infrastructure.
current_job_description: Building scalable REST APIs using FastAPI and Node.js. Managing PostgreSQL databases with performance optimization. Integrating third-party APIs and webhook systems.
previous_job_1_description: Developed REST APIs for internal tooling. Worked on Node.js backend services and MongoDB.
skills_text: Python, FastAPI, Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, AWS, LangChain, OpenAI API, Git, REST APIs, WebSockets
_identity_note: These are voluntary EEO questions asked by US companies. Answer or leave blank.
disability_status: No, I do not have a disability
why_leaving_current_job: I am looking for opportunities to work on more challenging problems and contribute to a team that values engineering excellence and innovation.
biggest_achievement: Built an AI-powered job autofill Chrome extension that reduces application time by 80% — now working on scaling it into a full career automation product.
where_do_you_see_yourself: In 3-5 years, I see myself as a senior backend engineer or engineering lead, architecting systems that serve millions of users and mentoring junior engineers.
strengths: Problem-solving, building scalable APIs, learning new technologies quickly, and shipping high-quality code under deadlines.
weaknesses: I sometimes over-engineer solutions for the sake of perfection. I am actively working on balancing pragmatism with perfectionism by setting clear delivery milestones.
describe_yourself: I am a backend engineer who is passionate about AI, automation, and building tools that genuinely improve people's productivity. I enjoy working in fast-paced environments where I can own features end-to-end.
biggest_challenge: Debugging a race condition in a distributed event-driven system that only appeared under production load. I resolved it by implementing distributed locking with Redis.
leadership_example: Led the migration of our legacy REST API to a fully async FastAPI setup, coordinating across 3 engineers and delivering the project 2 weeks ahead of schedule.
conflict_resolution: I believe in transparent, data-driven discussions. When I disagreed with a technical decision, I prepared a comparison document with benchmarks and presented it to the team. We adopted the better approach collaboratively.
teamwork_example: Worked with frontend, design, and DevOps to release a real-time notification system within a tight 2-week sprint. Regular standups and shared Notion docs kept everyone aligned.
